title: WMI or CIM process creation with an explicit target selector
description: Detects Win32_Process creation with a WMIC node, PowerShell computer-name or CIM-session selector. These selectors may still resolve to the local computer; remote execution and successful creation require destination evidence.

hypothesis.summary: An adversary may use Windows WMI or CIM to execute a process on a remote endpoint.
hypothesis.rationale: Microsoft documents Win32_Process.Create as a remote execution mechanism and MITRE recommends covering WMIC, PowerShell and other WMI interfaces; legitimate remote administration can use the same functionality.
hypothesis.detection_goal: Identify explicit process-creation methods with a target selector while excluding queries, other classes and other methods. The selector alone does not establish that a destination is remote.

data_sources.name: Microsoft Defender for Endpoint process events

triage.summary: Resolve the source and destination hosts, command and initiating account, then validate whether remote administration authorized the execution.
steps: Review the complete WMIC or PowerShell command, source device, remote target, account, parent process and requested child command.
Inspect authentication, network and process activity on the destination around the same time and determine what actually executed.
Confirm an approved software-management or administrative workflow; isolate affected endpoints and contain the account if the remote execution is unauthorized.
false_positives: Approved remote administration, software deployment, configuration management and support automation

validation.expected_outcome: Match WMIC process call create or PowerShell Win32_Process Create with an explicit target selector; reject remote queries, wrong classes or methods and absent selectors.

limitations: Authorized administration can produce this event. The rule does not independently establish compromise or completion of a command; assess identity, target and change approval.
Current-revision evidence is synthetic only. Validate full generated KQL, source fields, ingestion delay, alert volume and scoped exclusions in the target before enabling.
